collection.title: Jaguar XF Sportbrake 2012 to 2017 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Jaguar XF Sportbrake 2012 - 2017 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this XF Sportbrake, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
